## Capability use

Explain every requested permission. For wallet, redeem-code, subscription, or email
writes, describe the recipient, limits, idempotency keys, and retry behavior.

## Maintainer review

- [ ] Public source corresponds to the release artifacts.
- [ ] Declared permissions have documented uses.
- [ ] Financial and entitlement operations have bounded, reviewable behavior.
- [ ] Source and bundled frontend contain no obfuscated code.
- [ ] Publisher ownership is verified; new prefixes require `publisher-approved`.
